subject: cosmetology
intro: Cosmetology leads to the licensed personal-care trades — cutting and colouring hair, treating skin and nails — where state licences and salon chemistry meet people's daily appearance.

roles.title: Hairdressers, Hairstylists, and Cosmetologists
roles.what: Provide beauty services such as cutting, colouring and styling hair and massaging and treating the scalp; many also shampoo, apply makeup, dress wigs, remove hair and provide nail and skincare services.
roles.where: The hair sciences and services unit is the core of the work — hair structure and chemistry behind colour and chemical services, the cutting and styling craft, and the infection-control unit's sanitation rules in daily salon practice.

roles.title: Barbers
roles.what: Provide barbering services: cutting, trimming, shampooing and styling hair, trimming beards, and giving shaves — work performed on clippers, razors and shears that touch the skin daily.
roles.where: Cutting and styling technique and the disinfection and sanitation protocols from the infection-control unit underpin barbering's shave and beard work, where tools break skin and hygiene is regulated by state law.

roles.title: Skincare Specialists
roles.what: Provide skincare treatments to the face and body to enhance an individual's appearance; the occupation includes electrologists and laser hair removal specialists working alongside estheticians.
roles.where: The skin care unit maps straight onto this role — skin structure and analysis before every treatment, facials and treatments, and hair removal — with salon chemistry safety governing the products used.

roles.title: Manicurists and Pedicurists
roles.what: Clean and shape customers' fingernails and toenails, and polish or decorate them — from routine manicures and pedicures to artificial nail systems applied in salons.
roles.where: The nail technology unit covers the whole scope — nail structure and disorders that decide what can safely be worked on, manicure and pedicure procedure, and artificial nails — under the same sanitation standards.
